The [Anthropic Economic Index](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw) is an ongoing research initiative by Anthropic that tracks how individuals, enterprises, and economies use the Claude AI model. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESrQEB6zswFeM_cNzkPhJk8ragR3JffNjzKadq8YHBPx5HIEWjwjp_fz5K3nNe3huzzAWQcCF1ddjNRC1Z8SDHqjN5ep7lJDHyFJy7_QlY4zQ1TXY6hxEp0U-wXDN_fbWZl6Ez4GItZbnkzW4GuhkEtvo2rGQXPlL5RDgw7WNfhFFGPBSTH1Tn-xZaoT_snybDk7IKKD0a_0iT0wnIsc9KEk2FYYfllaUols2xQGEmrQ)]
Key Concepts & Components

* Economic Primitives: The index breaks down AI interactions using core metrics like task complexity, required human skills, use case (work, personal, or coursework), AI autonomy (delegation vs. collaboration), and task reliability/success rate. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVRWl92HHoU_f4ehaqDEPn4046g7VW6zkY3Al8Yq3ppqO6d_NjxEI_mMVY9JsDL6j7SzmDkl5bBED1fdlIwH8L4cJ5asByhhjjMbwsu0oAEQ90nWfto13QuInzhLpsrA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAV6GV44gX4-sl0rt4m6EaQsJH8Nh4K4BsN1_juJve7LhimLJhXBIQ9y36r7Im6UruwOP5JagzQVm70XMCMZDx_XdBAFLcxFzgpdt4X_pAfQ90CZWl9YuLWw5V6uY8vng), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw)]
* Augmentation vs. Automation: Research shows that most consumer usage leans toward augmentation (collaborative "thinking partner" interactions like iterative editing, learning, and validation) rather than complete delegation or full automation. However, enterprise API users increasingly use Claude for specialized, automated workflows. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFc5pXwWQAbGgSADZauXFgL9hFIWouAK4CtZKmGBoyk9IS4Qw-393LTw0xwc6QnnIwR8gqZIBkIYoNrgDbIpL8q8QoomefPVVbwou4l7wR444h7Ig4XwTIZ3md1oGlji7aNfjq2wFsfy0JzTTawgFVJQWfIWzkalLDsQTRw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVRWl92HHoU_f4ehaqDEPn4046g7VW6zkY3Al8Yq3ppqO6d_NjxEI_mMVY9JsDL6j7SzmDkl5bBED1fdlIwH8L4cJ5asByhhjjMbwsu0oAEQ90nWfto13QuInzhLpsrA)]
* Geographic & Economic Disparities: Usage is heavily concentrated in high-income nations (such as Australia, Switzerland, Luxembourg, and the United States) and tech-forward urban centers relative to population size. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEB6zswFfO7w_1WAnSZ4wgfDW5LS24WqxhvdAnKy14mX-DUDkEWuaFopnBHwxstZZ55nIy0raARuDjGDH7MBR2GZDA3AKRnojhgV7LWy9yP-BulbeDt1rQBnqHUAi6DhXe8Z5TR_dTO8I7sF2Ag9G_kFhHAwZtGH9iF1v45lWVDBcYvoJL2_cVcUUisblV5C5HJG5i4-byBmYk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI)]
* Top Industries & Job Types: Technical and analytical roles—such as computer and mathematical occupations, arts and media, and educational instruction—lead in volume and concentration of usage. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw)]
* Interactive Tool: Anthropic provides open datasets and an in-app Claude connector that lets users query the index data directly in plain language. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVooMtJDuZl5WbLc0Klfizh5ZHJYjGpz7ftBw9Wwrd7bLdxP6AcCMlr4s1exbSBkr6JwB4ZrTRBiYVtn3dn_8z5w6mvJfEf4bZak1m2oR560MeA6iTy3frDQrw2XvQlI896zK-), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI)]

GDPval is an AI benchmark created by [OpenAI](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg) to measure how well artificial intelligence models perform on real-world, economically valuable knowledge-work tasks rather than academic or math tests. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAV5e1D92fjl4arLGgbWubPM_woQLTk88wKqtsjeycDpo4ugmHlLKBY2Jmgp8L30J-U1cjOBDae-FiGJbaIH7bL25Gw_j2LadpPeqBjk_YuRdt18qQ), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAV9ofAr51RKj_rQOL_JfwndrUjbdpvWVx4myclZBWUACpQsLQQr7iFpEKr_duZsBLrpkrlAoqbGGtym3eGY9RndTjy_G59i1bkd9_MPHYhOve8DUZHKa5q2sD_cYLYHw)]
Key Details

* Scope: Covers 1,320 specialized tasks across 44 occupations derived from the top 9 U.S. GDP-contributing sectors. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESggEB6zswFe2tOqXCoWJa8bALG0Q6O5sjAYGmf7a-oLxpTbJ5qcxu6is-NOEdLzyAP_TIRy2vrAjnFfnuluIIeOfIEfPV872RvaFirwwF_vUZXYXjICql23SYvHpMv7sZFHmkLHVIVYJzczNBsFmwduVAWTTPIgCcWPq2-FHAEQuna1nC), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg)]
* Task Design: Built by industry professionals with an average of 14 years of experience using actual work products like legal briefs, spreadsheets, and engineering blueprints. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEB6zswFdiU5v-2bvjveGnb5VRaIqHJGLAx1zx-bqb3KsbzMazsgASe6Zy4djwyaLew68L1JAn-FDVpHmeQc3N_-X86VuIb26GT8zxguER68zFWXuHizxS4XvKq1frf8xehgvnN49PX29xVueyA3NAeYTJX9ilMrDsgnSZTq7lfGlU), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg)]
* Evaluation: Uses blind head-to-head comparisons by human experts to grade model outputs against human work. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESggEB6zswFe2tOqXCoWJa8bALG0Q6O5sjAYGmf7a-oLxpTbJ5qcxu6is-NOEdLzyAP_TIRy2vrAjnFfnuluIIeOfIEfPV872RvaFirwwF_vUZXYXjICql23SYvHpMv7sZFHmkLHVIVYJzczNBsFmwduVAWTTPIgCcWPq2-FHAEQuna1nC)]
* Open Source Set: Includes a gold open-sourced subset of 220 tasks available via [Hugging Face Datasets](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVm5FY12OrrM0U6PSxauyQdUwzN8-8rk1Z-9EU8DSkpEJyiaghIjM8OUDTTTwYY9F3FOr1suUN7D-RQdFC44Y8DZqzlNkNd4_3MEsmBpgPdNQl0PKHVzYpyxlHs1qyhSgQ) and detailed in the [ArXiv Research Paper](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAV5e1D92fjl4arLGgbWubPM_woQLTk88wKqtsjeycDpo4ugmHlLKBY2Jmgp8L30J-U1cjOBDae-FiGJbaIH7bL25Gw_j2LadpPeqBjk_YuRdt18qQ). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVm5FY12OrrM0U6PSxauyQdUwzN8-8rk1Z-9EU8DSkpEJyiaghIjM8OUDTTTwYY9F3FOr1suUN7D-RQdFC44Y8DZqzlNkNd4_3MEsmBpgPdNQl0PKHVzYpyxlHs1qyhSgQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAV5e1D92fjl4arLGgbWubPM_woQLTk88wKqtsjeycDpo4ugmHlLKBY2Jmgp8L30J-U1cjOBDae-FiGJbaIH7bL25Gw_j2LadpPeqBjk_YuRdt18qQ)]
* Leaderboards: Evaluated by frameworks like [Artificial Analysis GDPval-AA v2.1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAVgAjm8sR1LVSiS9i7GzX2qM_VLeqRumJBavESmc8WxlV73ea4yA7gFz_me9eppW0Og-Ml_WxAMVWD3bWEpsY0O2plbNqtIGV7xMNVdQ7190-HFX_X5hjx_vrKAGEnxHNh9xe-HRA4). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAVgAjm8sR1LVSiS9i7GzX2qM_VLeqRumJBavESmc8WxlV73ea4yA7gFz_me9eppW0Og-Ml_WxAMVWD3bWEpsY0O2plbNqtIGV7xMNVdQ7190-HFX_X5hjx_vrKAGEnxHNh9xe-HRA4)]

Microsoft integrates artificial intelligence across its core software ecosystem, enterprise infrastructure, and internal operations, while shifting toward massive AI data center investments and proprietary model development. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVhimdPZNcHXJRkYjIwI6IbygJm7Nh3E8ey73zLONmX2E69rF_5N0xCtt6i2OxX8_5xOBXyob7FoXj7vBJVqkYScQeDrtiipEDeGVHiyIqJL8FCoiiSQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAV2i8jakhLfFZ0PWPyscbuCQAoWv1IvTdHRgcdlP8XVG7mh3n-WvCAUt-58TFGBMZbTykLxTUzaccNDZrye2QLqm_Vq5XNtUncUYXgoSUWyogUQHgb3KCjxyZAhSHgbw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESxQEB6zswFdAn0PXCR3SMOTU2ViQaEW1HjbwXNfAMG74vsPArG6uygxnwpCdMmzpUgaSakEyGxUG6ICHmqYPf5voQpt_1qcNbKiWU2GNFEN-5qjccYGYrHpL7YNuW8sE_EIENT_wA60eu4QkJXOMO-BHPhAY1C4V4OalxYiAQiXulOVnPI1BvJiHD8fkhSm188oQmGnBKpmsc2thLmvlxkAmFbyLeQjmAakY9kTbzmoqpOf2O5rVhI2Pw360uHUkOWEzHP9kwZw)]
Key AI Products & Platforms

* Microsoft Copilot: An AI-powered assistant embedded across Microsoft 365 apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams) and Windows to draft content, summarize meetings, and analyze data. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXwHrOzAVxL4FO-J_UnaSLJmzHo1dLMH8x6XvNL0kfdNbBwoEFcBfzOo9vEKoCrf1Kc8tbIzT94JmNT_ZaGh6b6DB6V-_9rLhCgNh8xyfmaa2y4quzTc_gJeymBU5gu62), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVtNMK-6lwvyKl6gMYxw-2D3tu6Z-AMH7hhqzwLUSDGREJuBu1MWy-UB9BCqVYYjgdhQ4Bk5iwr1CR_OJCQ0J5qqD7AtVRvV8pkufuhXcZYSFV5SI9vNjwPT4mpgh6pCkSz5c_eE9almEYvUVhuujmSQ)]
* Azure AI: Cloud infrastructure providing enterprise-grade machine learning tools, model hosting, data security, and compliance mechanisms. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVhimdPZNcHXJRkYjIwI6IbygJm7Nh3E8ey73zLONmX2E69rF_5N0xCtt6i2OxX8_5xOBXyob7FoXj7vBJVqkYScQeDrtiipEDeGVHiyIqJL8FCoiiSQ)]
* Microsoft Fabric: A unified data and intelligence platform connecting analytics and AI workloads. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVhimdPZNcHXJRkYjIwI6IbygJm7Nh3E8ey73zLONmX2E69rF_5N0xCtt6i2OxX8_5xOBXyob7FoXj7vBJVqkYScQeDrtiipEDeGVHiyIqJL8FCoiiSQ)]
* Homegrown MAI Models: Microsoft has increasingly developed its own internal AI models (such as audio and multimodal tech) alongside its partnership with OpenAI. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESxQEB6zswFdAn0PXCR3SMOTU2ViQaEW1HjbwXNfAMG74vsPArG6uygxnwpCdMmzpUgaSakEyGxUG6ICHmqYPf5voQpt_1qcNbKiWU2GNFEN-5qjccYGYrHpL7YNuW8sE_EIENT_wA60eu4QkJXOMO-BHPhAY1C4V4OalxYiAQiXulOVnPI1BvJiHD8fkhSm188oQmGnBKpmsc2thLmvlxkAmFbyLeQjmAakY9kTbzmoqpOf2O5rVhI2Pw360uHUkOWEzHP9kwZw)]

Workplace Transformation & Workforce Impact

* Workflow Redesign: Microsoft emphasizes redesigning end-to-end business processes and deploying specialized AI agents rather than just dropping tools into old routines. A "canary in a coal mine" is an early warning sign or indicator of hidden danger, trouble, or failure. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVEqRzLnZhV5mcWA7F_hu8yR8AcWPyxWvFaKw3jfarHSB8vnYaKGaK6j36zRikDdgt_7KM9X1QbNsZaMLy8KX2Li7tH5GCczZ4JahVHGbZKis6QUBGipyTJFWarekt9Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
Historical Origin

* Toxic gas detection: In the late 19th and 20th centuries, coal miners brought caged canaries into underground tunnels. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVH1drH5NI4jXNCYpOPyKxfv1305tVWQ86XWSovAFqRfU2V8S85Kbxq3Y1UhfLBMkMzEX1dsL-qNm79T9oMWjw1GtXVXutW8gLkicuZeV3aK4fztuccKcsmHN0taTv), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVa_5SekDXQbkaCZ8gmIC4BtGeH3ADFaiopOiykFS4cyJtZXmmT6FFn7kvoSgOMG2LmFIaJXaKOjJ5ZehBnpms5iknHbqaHx5JlP6anx4QwbnDjnHG6Dxd1ln6Tr2OYw)]
* Physiology: Canaries have a rapid breathing rate and high metabolism, making them much more sensitive to lethal, odorless gases like carbon monoxide and methane than humans. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEB6zswFSO5H75EU10vINs9SOmfnxiaGnrN_H3H4Z4DkU39fNQYFj0FEoMOKoEDKoSYteMEFaPB5qi0mY5Sn36b6tCUfUNPKNREcQUGBmXD8D5rTd9lc6pP12KHq7grmiuglVJE0zMGK2-35Iul72rBV24Nb0QY0C57oVYZGR_K2eCAkLKJmtRxUUM1DXxx2gPyXJ1S6A), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAES2AEB6zswFcFG8Oa3_RCjdVIHPuTOJ8mwMQLAnWielJU9GovMM5khTG3tNwWqDPfdMkesFgPui4ggrEUxa8D03kfIAWTQNJo6pCniVKc5Ud_hhqllV8daNccEeeBkm6jy0Z9lad5DiwRfMl-wvzy4tSH0bhDTsg4cuECHOUuNUE6QaYyQnGePhWldSCP74MrFzMA6oZnyWGoNZMeJVNMW-EDStZG_sf1KhnRToqf7Vr1wVL5FUnq3_YUru7d4eFcod1qtteGP4lXBo7LEIg597JfqDlk60Ni2x2I)]
* The warning signal: As long as the bird sang and acted normally, the air was safe. If the canary grew distressed, fell silent, or collapsed, it signaled that poisonous gas was building up and miners needed to escape. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVTOpgmdrF8RpGKlFLXDfKJ023XeBlxSYaHGsLb5N_KtiDD_h0IMyn0uZNSMAH_--vKuqO9RcgMBkW3a2BcjMkuuIC7KWZNx8lqVWWhENFHOXscc8VtTmlV3mL9raewBBfrbcW), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFT9qJXl1mov9iH0FSD06go8edvUa1sPoh-j4oPaiZnr8gOVUZ_aA-edkzAQNg1AMRQQOqriZrjBpJ8HOfCDIwMuH5BPWKzxKCYQc-ut0AogTcTe8PvrxyGTJZy4BSPY6iNdbcQVXWS71b1AceLAVjFtqOs1Z4PxeYRg_-7QBKQcnTz3rv9OjeH9FFkwLs6PUzt9_jI-dfwqlkk92m6U), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVH1drH5NI4jXNCYpOPyKxfv1305tVWQ86XWSovAFqRfU2V8S85Kbxq3Y1UhfLBMkMzEX1dsL-qNm79T9oMWjw1GtXVXutW8gLkicuZeV3aK4fztuccKcsmHN0taTv)]
* Replacement: The practice continued until electronic gas detectors replaced live birds in the late 20th century (around 1996). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVw9cH-m4LMwad3zjiP3B4hA79l243daKPbJdHGCC_f6oam843iAmtOiZllECSVPCs9NrnimN8V7HSVcn--MCpxQjFkKS0E2yo9l7nEiDNREeeXZXB_pzBXhRTJWRMlrpx0o05ZQufROpIobtculxefg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVTOpgmdrF8RpGKlFLXDfKJ023XeBlxSYaHGsLb5N_KtiDD_h0IMyn0uZNSMAH_--vKuqO9RcgMBkW3a2BcjMkuuIC7KWZNx8lqVWWhENFHOXscc8VtTmlV3mL9raewBBfrbcW)]

Modern Idiom & Metaphor
Today, the phrase describes anything that breaks down or shows negative changes first during a larger crisis: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVw9cH-m4LMwad3zjiP3B4hA79l243daKPbJdHGCC_f6oam843iAmtOiZllECSVPCs9NrnimN8V7HSVcn--MCpxQjFkKS0E2yo9l7nEiDNREeeXZXB_pzBXhRTJWRMlrpx0o05ZQufROpIobtculxefg)]

* Economics: Declining hotel occupancy or airport traffic used as an early sign of an incoming economic downturn. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
* Environment: Melting glaciers, dying coral reefs, or disappearing insects used as early warnings for climate change and ecosystem stress. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVEqRzLnZhV5mcWA7F_hu8yR8AcWPyxWvFaKw3jfarHSB8vnYaKGaK6j36zRikDdgt_7KM9X1QbNsZaMLy8KX2Li7tH5GCczZ4JahVHGbZKis6QUBGipyTJFWarekt9Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
* Technology & Labor: Studies such as the [Stanford Digital Economy Lab](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEB6zswFfWR09Ro4231Ymf6sqMG9zJt7dFxoNTpKPKnikT5ywAVg9Aqfb9SSURLIlLADj7qvuNW6ia3tcW9jcckyANjv2P9J6HhS_OYAnlWXeKBGYy8lUCIlAQZRVJcKozP5OvAP_TBzBBr4YBQAZQd3nzXkpMPRW9Wbuy3jCQHRx22P806YwiGsVeRSx5BDJ6IPFWprzuOpHU21vfwnLVlz0xaWfThHUKLMMUxnpUn4HdhfvnNJVz1jP2L3akkP6gbePN5br7YQZ1nadI) report tracking entry-level or young worker employment shifts as early indicators of artificial intelligence impacts on the job market. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEB6zswFfWR09Ro4231Ymf6sqMG9zJt7dFxoNTpKPKnikT5ywAVg9Aqfb9SSURLIlLADj7qvuNW6ia3tcW9jcckyANjv2P9J6HhS_OYAnlWXeKBGYy8lUCIlAQZRVJcKozP5OvAP_TBzBBr4YBQAZQd3nzXkpMPRW9Wbuy3jCQHRx22P806YwiGsVeRSx5BDJ6IPFWprzuOpHU21vfwnLVlz0xaWfThHUKLMMUxnpUn4HdhfvnNJVz1jP2L3akkP6gbePN5br7YQZ1nadI)]

The [AI Labor Market Tracker](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw) by The Budget Lab at Yale finds no clear evidence of large-scale or economy-wide labor market disruption from artificial intelligence. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
Key Findings

* Minimal Economy-Wide Impact: Data updated through September 2026 shows that employment, unemployment rates, and wage trends for AI-exposed workers largely mirror historical patterns and pre-AI trajectories. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEB6zswFUFOomgOgPje6vL2Nwt8kKIkyFfDa3mEgDtHijmg0AqfaZFHyY_5OLNXxZjmZg2f1iFYkhlgRT0FVbFMko_1OZFG7IHW_PRB3tyHT9y3GNiKPlbeWdaClCMAfbptvGgflRmS7pbMpFoB9hsYt0jzOOF2VM8o1XaGzWGlLdm22glsdMAre454DkigUWqONIE), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* No Unusual Occupational Churn: Changes in the mix of occupations across industries (occupational churn) remain flat and show no acceleration or divergence since the late 2022 launch of ChatGPT. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEB6zswFUFOomgOgPje6vL2Nwt8kKIkyFfDa3mEgDtHijmg0AqfaZFHyY_5OLNXxZjmZg2f1iFYkhlgRT0FVbFMko_1OZFG7IHW_PRB3tyHT9y3GNiKPlbeWdaClCMAfbptvGgflRmS7pbMpFoB9hsYt0jzOOF2VM8o1XaGzWGlLdm22glsdMAre454DkigUWqONIE), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* Exposed vs. Unexposed Workers: Synthetic differences-in-differences comparisons between AI-exposed and unexposed workers reveal no strong, consistent statistical footprint of AI-driven displacement, though slight volatility in unemployment growth for high-exposure groups continues to be monitored. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEB6zswFU8sZI9umZ2DaxfmwRfZr1972sBeix2wLuwOhLoUq5X1vYEdxBkdpbY8s_DfpNIyKLMl4fDJDDV2fLqLcn6KcxDk8VJa1PwFM2DzhKpRKBLfr1vqpDAsD_pgkpQJCQVat08N1HcCLCwp2tv5Gc9cRpaO2QZl88QTv4GVHfvrBdrRuMLLexFwvYc), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* Capital vs. Labor: Companies cutting jobs or restructuring are generally doing so for broader macro or capital-investment reasons rather than direct workforce replacement by AI agents. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVg4dxPb7X6tGYFmXwN4kEpYjrk14__zb8lre1s8NorHsnn0T4uLoyR1SeXe1DaHaI5uG0Qf5r8aajEVbtjuuK3OQndqY_s6h9-Nw9IRgHpMs9KP05gWucXZRopwE-tw)]

Interactive Tracker Sections
You can explore the live data via the [The Budget Lab](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw), which breaks down trends into three primary areas: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]

* Occupational Churn: Tracks how fast job roles and industry composition are shifting over time. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* AI Metrics: Evaluates various index measurements of AI task exposure across standard occupational classifications. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEB6zswFTsJCpN3LfkWeR8cD8dNHhJ65UXoox0P0ctL-4y_AWwGcYpRMxkwYYZOIfSIK_MK2hEwCnJ_arp7ZOxcqeHijyuQMGTcU_NePeojOiKLw9f7tkBTLs2WVfDDnAY1rsWinK4PIVf723WZByuReArXzgSURiYWLxJsg3rYLP5kqNk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* Comparisons: Analyzes employment, wage, and unemployment trajectories of workers in high- versus low-AI exposure categories. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
